title: Capstone: Containerize, Ship & Operate an App

questions.prompt: What is the correct order of the end-to-end workflow?

options.text: Containerize, run locally with Compose, CI/CD (build/test/push), deploy, operate

questions.explanation: The workflow flows from packaging the app to running it locally, publishing it via CI/CD, deploying it, and operating it in production.

options.text: Advertise the image on Docker Hub
Deploy the exact same tested image (by tag or digest) through each environment unchanged
Rebuild the image for each environment
Increase the image's tag number automatically

questions.explanation: Promotion means moving one immutable, tested artifact through staging to production without rebuilding, so what runs is exactly what passed CI.

questions.prompt: In the capstone Compose file, why does the api service use depends_on with condition: service_healthy?

options.text: So the api starts only after the database reports healthy, avoiding connection errors

questions.explanation: The readiness gate makes the api wait for the database's healthcheck to pass, so it does not race ahead and fail to connect.

questions.prompt: To recover from a bad deployment, you redeploy the ______ image or digest, since old versions are kept available. (one word)
questions.explanation: Because you deploy immutable images and keep old ones, rollback is redeploying the previous image/digest — fast and reliable.

questions.prompt: Which practices does the capstone Dockerfile combine? Select all that apply.

options.text: A multi-stage build with a slim runtime base
A HEALTHCHECK and cache-friendly instruction ordering
Baking production secrets into an ENV

questions.explanation: It uses multi-stage builds, a non-root user, a healthcheck, and manifest-before-source ordering. Secrets are never baked into the image.

questions.prompt: Order what happens to one commit as it flows through the pipeline and deploy.

items.text: The image is built and tagged (version + SHA)
The image is pushed to the registry
That same image is deployed and monitored

questions.explanation: Tests gate the build; the built image is pushed; then the exact same image is promoted to deployment and operated.
